species.name: Moonbell

dex.text: A pale bell that drifts wherever the tide drifts it, with four lilac rings in the middle like a very calm clover. Not in the slightest bit hurried.
dex.fact: A moon jellyfish has no brain, no heart and no bones, and the four rings in its bell are its reproductive organs.

species.real: A moon jellyfish is about 95 per cent water, and its sting is too mild for most people to feel.

species.name: Aurelian

dex.text: Glows faintly at night and trails four frilled arms the colour of spilt wine. It looks like a chandelier that has decided to go to sea.
dex.fact: Moon jellyfish are one of the commonest jellyfish around British coasts, and they pulse gently to swim and to push food towards their mouth.

species.real: The scientific name of the moon jellyfish, Aurelia aurita, means 'eared golden one', after the lobes around its rim.
